subject: SOC 2 & ISO audit partner appointment — recommendation and renewal plan
messages:
From: Jessica Moreno <jessica@brightlineaudit.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/ISO audit RFP - initial scope and pricing

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks for the RFP and the opportunity to respond. Attached is Brightline Advisory's response to your SOC 2 / ISO 27001 engagement request (Brightline_RFP_response_20260518.pdf). High-level notes: we propose a 12-week external audit window with a 3-week evidence collection period, remote evidence collection by default with an optional 2 onsite days for key interviews, and a firm-fixed price for the annual assessment.

Estimated fees (baseline):
- SOC 2 Type II: $72,000
- ISO 27001 recertification: $28,000
- Multi-year (2+ years) advisory: 7% annual discount

We included references for two recent cloud-native SaaS clients and a proposed schedule. For scope clarity, we flagged items where we anticipate additional work (third-party data centers and custom encryption controls).

Attachments: Brightline_RFP_response_20260518.pdf

Would welcome 30 minutes to walk through the assumptions. Are you available this week?

Best,
Jessica Moreno
Partner, Brightline Advisory
jessica@brightlineaudit.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Moreno <jessica@brightlineaudit.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/ISO audit RFP - initial scope and pricing

Jessica — thanks for the quick response and the detailed packet.

A few clarifying items before we hop on a call:
- Evidence collection: can you confirm what you expect from our engineering team vs. what you will pull via API/console snapshots? Any templated evidence lists you can share would speed evaluation.
- Pricing: is the SOC 2/ISO bundled figure above inclusive of any remediation advisory hours or strictly the audit? We want an apples-to-apples between quotes.
- Multi-year terms: what contractual protections do you require for discounts (are they subject to scope creep)?

I've attached the previous year's snapshot and our internal control inventory for reference (internal_only_audit_summary_2025.pdf).

If we can get answers by EOD Thursday I'll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for Friday.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Jessica Moreno <jessica@brightlineaudit.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/ISO audit RFP - initial scope and pricing

Markus — appreciate the questions. Quick answers below and a revised line-item quote attached.

- Evidence collection: Brightline performs a hybrid approach. We provide an evidence matrix (controls -> examples) and can collect logs/config snapshots via temporary read-only API tokens where supported. We expect engineering to provide access to audit logs and access control lists; we will not extract data from production systems.
- Pricing: the quote is audit-only. Remediation/advisory is scoped separately — typical blocks are 40/80 hours priced at an hourly NTE.
- Multi-year: discounts are guaranteed in the SOW for unchanged scope; major scope changes will trigger an adjustment clause.

Attached: Brightline_Quote_v2.xlsx

Happy to run the Friday session to walk assumptions — propose Friday 10:00am PT.

Best,
Jessica
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2/ISO audit RFP - shortlist & internal next steps

Team — following the walkthroughs with Brightline and Northbridge (Northbridge sent a separate SOW draft), I pulled together a shortcomparison and recommendation spreadsheet (vendor_comparison_20260526.csv). Key takeaways:

- Brightline: strong pricing for audit-only, excellent cloud-native references, quicker turnaround (12 weeks) but less capacity for remediation advisory without additional headcount.
- Northbridge Assurance: slightly higher audit fee, includes 10 advisory hours in year 1 and a dedicated engagement manager; proposed 2-year renewal pricing with fixed annual increases capped at 3%.

Risks: Northbridge's initial SOW includes an onsite visit requirement that will cost travel; Brightline flags potential additional effort for our custom encryption control mapping.

Recommended route: appoint Northbridge as primary audit partner on a 2-year contract (SOW draft attached: Northbridge_SOW_draft_20260601.docx) to lock in renewal pricing and a bundled advisory block. If legal raises concerns about the onsite clause, negotiate to make on-site optional. Next steps:
- Markus: sign-off on final vendor choice
- Laura: coordinate legal redlines
- Karthik / Finance: approve PO and payment terms

I scheduled a 30-minute decision sync for Tues Jun 1 — please confirm attendance.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, procurement@northbridge-assure.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Decision: appoint Northbridge Assurance for SOC 2 & ISO program (PO issued)

Team and Northbridge — after reviewing the comparison and the SOW, we will appoint Northbridge Assurance as our SOC 2 and ISO audit partner for an initial two-year engagement. Action items:

1) Monica / Finance: please issue PO PO-2026-358 and confirm payment terms (Net 30) with Northbridge.
2) Laura / Legal: proceed with SOW redlines; remove mandatory onsite days or make them conditional on scope escalation.
3) Northbridge (contracts@northbridge-assure.com): please confirm receipt of this email and acknowledge the PO number; attach an invoice and final SOW for signature.

Note: Brightline delivered a strong proposal and should remain on the preferred vendor list for audit-only quotes. We may keep them as a secondary provider for short audits. Appreciate everyone's work to get this done on a tight timeline.

Markus Klein
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
